whatsNew.en-US:
Back up your library: export your prompts, favorites, categories and chats to a file in Settings, and restore them on any device. Restoring only adds to your library and never deletes anything.

Your most-used prompts are now one tap away with a new Recently Used shelf and a Most Used sort.

Swipe right on a prompt to favorite it, or left to copy or delete it. Copy is also in every long-press menu, and you can select several prompts to delete at once.

Premium purchases now complete reliably, including Ask to Buy approvals and purchases made on another device.

Bug fixes and improvements.
whatsNew.zh-Hans:
备份你的资料库：在设置中将提示词、收藏、分类和对话导出为文件，并在任何设备上恢复。恢复只会新增内容，绝不会删除任何项目。

全新的“最近使用”栏和“最常使用”排序，让常用的提示词一触即达。

在提示词上向右轻扫即可收藏，向左轻扫可拷贝或删除。长按菜单中也新增了“拷贝”，还可以一次选择多个提示词进行删除。

高级版购买现在更加可靠，包括“询问购买”的批准以及在其他设备上完成的购买。

问题修复与体验改进。
